summary: Ship blocked: retry loop can re-deliver a message after a partial failure.

findings.title: Retry without idempotency key
findings.body: The worker retries the whole batch after a partial failure, so already-delivered items are sent again.
findings.recommendation: Record delivered ids before the retry and skip them.
